answer: EigenTrust centrality is computed from reciprocity-weighted, transitive endorsements, while each contribution decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life; durable influence therefore requires sustained honest service. Freshly spawned sybil identities have little trusted incoming evidence and near-zero eigenvector centrality, so coordinated endorsements cannot lift them above the consensus threshold without persistent reciprocal trust. Even peers called ivory, whisper, or lantern gain no weight from their names alone.
